title: VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.26342v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. translated_title: VibeTraining-Bench：面向迭代式系统改进的数据-训练器-推理框架协同设计
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求智能体能够诊断系统瓶颈，并协调训练与推理层面的改进。我们将智能体联合优化训练数据、训练器和推理框架的能力称为跨组件协同设计。我们提出了VibeTraining-Bench，一个用于评估该能力的基准，涵盖终端操作、软件工程、多轮工具使用和数学推理等任务。在每个任务中，研究智能体从相同的初始智能体系统出发，在固定的资源预算下，依据验证反馈迭代地改进数据、训练器和推理框架，然后选择并提交最终的智能体系统以在测试集上进行评估。为防止奖励作弊，我们实施了三项保障措施：测试数据隔离、独立的研究与评分容器，以及针对研究智能体的网络限制。我们的评估结果显示……
tldr: 提出了VibeTraining-Bench基准，用于评估AI智能体在固定资源预算下协同优化训练数据、训练器与推理框架以实现递归自我改进的能力，并通过测试数据隔离、容器分离和网络限制等手段防止奖励作弊。
en_tdlr: VibeTraining-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating agents' cross-component co-design capability—jointly optimizing training data, trainers, and inference harnesses for recursive self-improvement—under fixed resource budgets, with safeguards against reward hacking.
